title: epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. hookeri
intro: Epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. hookeri, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus or Queen of the Night, is a type of cactus plant that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Epiphyllum phyllanthus subsp. hookeri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
